name: special_chebyshev_polynomial_t_out
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::special_chebyshev_polynomial_t.out(Tensor x, Tensor n, *, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!). The suite also covers the FlagGems scalar-degree wrapper corresponding to the n_scalar_out overload. It writes first-kind Chebyshev polynomial values into out, resizes empty and wrong-shape buffers to the broadcast result, accepts a float16 output cast from float32 computation, rejects an incompatible integer output buffer, mutates out, and returns the identical Python tensor object and its current storage.
